title: Patty Hearst’s Shock: Kidnapped, Joined Rebels?

scenes.text: In 1974, a 19‑year‑old heiress vanished for 19 days—then turned militant.
Patty Hearst was abducted by the Symbionese Liberation Army on February 4 1974.
